journey_status_by_progress.text: Right at the start of the path, with every sound, every word, and every story still ahead.
Past the trailhead now. The first letter sounds and patterns are starting to feel familiar.
Halfway up the mountain. Sounds are turning into words, and words are starting to carry real meaning.
Deep into the climb. Whole stories are starting to make sense, not just word by word.
Near the top now, with almost every skill on this map truly learned, not just visited.

phonics.tagline: The trailhead: turning letters and sounds into words you can read.
phonics.milestone_text: You've reached the end of the Phonics Path. Every sound and pattern here is one you can read on sight now, no sounding out required.

vocabulary.tagline: The middle stretch: turning words you can read into words you understand.
vocabulary.milestone_text: You've walked the whole Vocabulary Trail. Every word on it, you now know the meaning of, not just how to say out loud.

comprehension.tagline: The summit: turning the words on a page into a whole story you understand.
comprehension.milestone_text: You've reached the top of Comprehension Summit. Every story up here, you followed and understood, start to finish.
